qa_pairs.question: What type of memory information is available for users to review regarding their group members on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: On the Metrix portal, users can consult the memory usage for each individual within their group.

qa_pairs.question: For which specific entities can users monitor memory usage within their group on the Metrix portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can monitor the memory usage for each individual user within their group on the Metrix portal.
